      await mkdir(args["--v6-delivery-output"], { recursive: true, mode: 0o700 }).catch(() => undefined);
      await writeFile(path.join(args["--v6-delivery-output"], "V6_DELIVERY_FAILED"), "v6_delivery_failed_after_engineering_seal\n", { flag: "wx", mode: 0o600 }).catch(() => undefined);
      for (const name of ["prune.log", "dependencies.log"]) {
        const failureLog = await readFile(path.join(workRoot, "v6-delivery", name)).catch(() => null);
        if (failureLog) await writeFile(path.join(args["--v6-delivery-output"], `failed-${name}`), failureLog, { flag: "wx", mode: 0o600 }).catch(() => undefined);
      }
